labels.bugTracker: Enable the floating report button, default assignee, technician notifications, and email templates.

tooltips.bugTrackerEnabled: When disabled, the floating bug button is hidden and new reports cannot be created.
tooltips.bugTrackerDefaultAssignedUser: Assigned to new bug reports when the reporter does not pick an assignee.
tooltips.bugTrackerTechnicianUser: CRM user notified about new bugs (and used as assignee fallback).
tooltips.bugTrackerTechnicianEmail: Primary address for new-bug notifications. Falls back to the technician account email.
tooltips.bugTrackerNotifyEmailTemplate: Template sent to the technician when a bug is reported. Use Create to add a new template.
tooltips.bugTrackerClosedEmailTemplate: Template sent to the reporter when a bug is closed (if they have an email).
